name: PyHSS
description: Python Home Subscriber Server implementing Diameter/3GPP interfaces for LTE EPC networks. Supports HSS, VoLTE HSS, EIR, PCRF, and Gateway Mobile Location Centre roles.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker compose with services: diameter, hss, api, geored, logs, metrics, gsup, database. Run: cd docker && docker compose up --build -d. Dev image also available.

eval_notes: Feature-rich HSS with 8 containerized services including Diameter, API, metrics, and GSUP. Multiple database backends (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite). Perfect for testing subscriber management and Diameter signaling in 4G networks.
